content_voiceover: This flowchart shows the risk classification and treatment algorithm from the T P O G L C H twenty twenty three protocol. At the top, disease splits into multisystem versus single system, excluding critical organs. Multisystem disease further splits by risk organ status: multiple system multiple site with risk organ positive, meaning liver, spleen, or bone marrow involvement, versus risk organ negative, which can still include multifocal bone lesions. Single system disease splits into single system multiple site, single specific site involving weight bearing bone or CNS risk bone, and single site without fever, which goes straight to local therapy alone. Everyone else starts induction therapy one. For the risk organ positive group, there's an early evaluation at day fourteen to twenty one, while the other multisystem and single system multiple site groups are evaluated at the end of induction one, around day thirty five to forty two. Based on response, categorized as better, worse, others, or N A D meaning no active disease, patients either move to maintenance, continue with a second line approach, or proceed to induction therapy two. Importantly, all CNS risk bone lesions require induction therapy two regardless of the day thirty five response, because of the risk of CNS complications like diabetes insipidus. After induction two, response is reevaluated again, and patients who are others or worse may escalate to second or even third line therapy, while those who are better or greater proceed to maintenance. Maintenance duration is twelve months for multifocal bone disease only, and twenty four months for everyone else.
keypoints: Multisystem disease with risk organ (liver/spleen/marrow) positive gets early evaluation at D14-21
Others get evaluated at end of induction 1 (D35-42): response graded as NAD, better/worse, or others
CNS risk bone lesions always require induction therapy 2 regardless of D35 response
Maintenance: 12 months for multifocal bone only, 24 months for all other risk groups
keypoint_voiceover: The T P O G L C H twenty twenty three algorithm stratifies by multisystem versus single system disease and by risk organ status. Risk organ positive patients get an early day fourteen to twenty one evaluation, everyone else is evaluated at the end of induction one around day thirty five. All CNS risk bone lesions get induction therapy two no matter the response. And maintenance runs twelve months for multifocal bone only disease, but twenty four months for all other groups.
